design.scope: seven passing adaptive selections plus unchanged B4/E8
design.population: 109488 complete-response development respondents, same row order
design.weights: fixed equal-country weights on the full common development population
design.resamples: the existing 50 respondent and 50 country confirmation fits per model
design.matching: one-to-one Hungarian matching maximizing equal-country overlap
design.summaries: median, 10th percentile and minimum across 50 reference-versus-resample comparisons per test
design.new_cutoffs: none; these diagnostics do not replace the original median/p10 ARI filters
design.profiles: all original worry categories, separate personal/known-person harm, weighted and respondent prevalence
design.extra_clusters: weighted membership overlaps and original-category contrasts with the largest-overlap source cluster
design.limitations: different geometries; not a strict refinement lattice; fixed-reference comparisons, not independent validation
design.reference_diagnostic: reference-versus-repetition ARI and within-test ARI medoid from cached pairwise vectors; no representative is adopted
